about: Pathify's own interest statements, written for Indian students and organised by Holland's RIASEC model. Each statement is an activity, not a job title, so students rate what they enjoy rather than what sounds prestigious.

dimensions.name: Realistic
dimensions.description: Building, fixing and working with tools, machines, plants or animals.

dimensions.name: Investigative
dimensions.description: Asking why, solving problems, and working with ideas, data and science.

dimensions.name: Artistic
dimensions.description: Making things that express ideas: design, writing, music, film, performance.

dimensions.name: Social
dimensions.description: Teaching, caring for, guiding and working closely with people.

dimensions.name: Enterprising
dimensions.description: Leading, persuading, selling, and taking charge of plans and teams.

dimensions.name: Conventional
dimensions.description: Keeping things accurate and organised: records, numbers, schedules, rules.
